sloka: मम चैवानुजा साध्वी ऊर्मिला प्रियदर्शना ।भार्य्यार्थे लक्ष्मणस्यापि दत्ता पित्रा मम स्वयम् ॥ २.११८.५३॥
transliteration: mama caivānujā sādhvī ūrmilā priyadarśanā ।bhāryyārthe lakṣmaṇasyāpi dattā pitrā mama svayam ॥ 2.118.53॥

translations.english: My father, on his own accord, bestowed Urmila, my younger sister of chaste and of pleasing appearance as wife to Lakshmana.
